title: digitaria ischaemum subsp. stewartiana
intro: Digitaria ischaemum subsp. stewartiana, commonly known as finger grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to treat various health conditions such as fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of finger grass include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve pain, reduce fever, and clear mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of finger grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
